messages:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to align on dependencies for the Q3 Adaptive Routing launch. Customer-driven ask from MintCorp requires VPC + cost-aware routing. High level: runtime needs multi-model routing + cache compatibility, infra needs reserved capacity + autoscaler changes, security needs KMS/audit. Can owners call out blockers and rough ETA?

Sam: I can own runtime. Main work: model selection API, preserve KV cache across model variants, and rollback hooks. Risk: quantized variants can break outputs. Rough estimate 3 sprints (inc. eval harness).

Lee: Infra ack. We need new capacity reservation API + billing tags and a fallback quota for burst. Also want a graceful drain flow. Blocker: depends on runtime exposing model compatibility metadata. ETA 2 sprints after runtime API lands.

Miguel: Security aware. For MintCorp we need customer-managed KMS + audit trail for model routing decisions and data flows. I'll need a short design doc & threat model. Recommend ephemeral keys for routing tokens. ETA: 1 sprint for design + integration planning.

Alyssa: From product side proposed minimal launch criteria: 1) end-to-end canary with MintCorp dataset, 2) p95 latency <= 200ms for host model, 3) cost improvement >= 15% per-token for routed traffic, 4) quality delta <= 1.5% measured on eval set, 5) rollback/kill switch tested. Also need runbook + dashboard.

Sam: For the canary we'll add a feature-flagged rollout. Proposed rollout config:```
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  metrics: [p95_latency, acceptance_rate]
  fallback: true
  watch_interval: 10m
```
We need runtime metrics surfaced to the console (batched tokens, kv-hit-rate).

Lee: We'll add autoscaler hooks and reserve GPUs in the dedicated pool. Need tagging from API to route billing. Can someone file the infra ticket with exact API fields?

Priya: Filed PRODUCT-842 with initial fields. Please link infra/design docs there.

Miguel: Security question — are model weights considered customer data in this flow? For private deployments we need clear boundaries.

Sam: Model artifacts remain Redwood-managed for hosted variant; only request traces are customer-adjacent. We'll document. If customer demands private model hosting that's a separate flow.

Alyssa: Suggest weekly cross-team sync until canary is stable. Also propose a soft launch gate: MintCorp completes integration test suite and we see 48h of stable metrics.

Sam: Agree. I'll put up a draft runtime API spec by EOD Friday.

Lee: I'll schedule infra work items and unblock capacity procurement — cc @Priya for priority.

Miguel: I'll draft the threat model and KMS integration checklist, share by Tue.

InfraBot: Created meeting: "Adaptive Routing - cross-team kickoff" — Wed 11:00 PT — https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123

Priya: Thanks everyone — owners: Sam (runtime), Lee (infra), Miguel (security), Alyssa (launch ops). I'll own cross-team stakeholder comms. :thumbsup:

Sam: :thumbsup: noted owners and next steps.

Alyssa: Added launch checklist to PRODUCT-842.

Priya: Closing thread for now — will surface agenda for Wed meeting.
